cards.title: University Prep
cards.desc: Professional preparation program for all groups aiming for university admission.
cards.details: Structured subject roadmap, weekly assessments, and personalized feedback to maximize admission results.

cards.title: Master's Prep
cards.desc: Intensive courses in logic, informatics, and foreign language for master's exams.
cards.details: Exam-focused modules, speed techniques, and mock sessions designed around real test patterns.

cards.title: Civil Service
cards.desc: Special preparation program for civil service examinations and public sector careers.
cards.details: Targeted legal, analytical, and scenario-based training aligned with civil service exam requirements.

cards.title: MIG & Certification
cards.desc: Targeted preparation courses for MIG and international certification exams.
cards.details: Methodical coaching, exam simulations, and strategy-based mentoring for stronger certification outcomes.

cards.title: IELTS
cards.desc: IELTS-focused speaking, listening, reading, writing, and grammar training.
cards.details: Band score improvement plans with mentor reviews, timed practice, and individual speaking feedback.

cards.title: Preschool
cards.desc: Early development program for children aged 3-6 with interactive learning activities.
cards.details: Play-based sessions that support speech, logic, social adaptation, and confident school readiness.
